scope: Independent read-only review of bounded original DT/kallsyms capture and pinned public driver; no MMIO model, tests, QEMU run or tablet capture performed here.

capture.execution_note: Root ran one serialized capture after relay queue/rate-limit failures; reviewer subsequently read the saved Git blob and independently checked raw bytes and geometry.

native_boundary.provenance: Actual native-1fe4e1 kernel/QEMU observations supplied by root; this review independently checked the fixed DT and symbol identity, not re-executed the guest.
native_boundary.cpufreq_registration_message: cpufreq: driver qcom-cpufreq-hw up and running
native_boundary.source_correlation: The named en-base resource starts exactly at the rejected PA, and the pinned driver's init path first reads its bit0. The public OnePlus source is a correlated reference, not a claim that the private Image was built from that exact tree.

sources.purpose: Firmware-offloaded device frequency selection, with L3 given as an example; selects performance/powersave/userspace governors.

actual_dt.geometry_boundary: Three sparse resources end at 0x18590324; do not map the intervening holes or extend into CPUFreq domain0 at0x18591000. Child names identify software clients, not four independent hardware register banks.

source_contract.enable: Read32 en-base bit0 must already be set by firmware or a declared reference handoff. Linux does not write this register to enable it. Returning zero causes -ENODEV; default unknown must not silently become successful firmware state.
source_contract.ftbl: Read32 at ftbl-base+i*stride, i<40. Static file-level stride defaults4; this DT node supplies no override and160B fits40x4. No physical LUT words were measured. Other instances' effect on the shared static stride was not established by this single-node capture.
source_contract.decode: SRC=(word>>30)&3; MULT=word&255; SRC!=0 decodes19200000*MULT Hz, SRC==0 decodes300000000 Hz regardless of MULT. These are driver constants, not measured oscillator/GCC-parent routing.
source_contract.terminal: Stop at the second adjacent row with equal decoded frequency. The comment mentions core counts, but the executable condition checks only prev_freq==freq. Raw-word equality and CPU-count fields are not the condition.
source_contract.opp: Each accepted frequency is added with voltage0. There is no sourced voltage table or voltage register in this interface.
source_contract.perf: Target resolves the OPP into the software frequency-table index, then writes that u32 index to the one parent perf-base. A hardware-instance current-frequency read reads PERF and clamps it in guest software to max_state-1. A child current-frequency read returns its own software vote index without an MMIO read.
source_contract.voters: Each child copies parent OPPs and keeps an index in kernel RAM. Target under voter_lock selects the maximum index across the software list and writes the same single parent PERF word. No hardware voter registers are evidenced.
source_contract.registration: A parent with available children populates those children and does not register itself directly with devfreq. Each leaf registers the performance governor; polling_ms50 is Linux framework policy, not a modeled hardware sample period.
no_source_for: firmware execution or shared-memory command processing

minimum_reference_boundary.scope: If implemented next, expose only the three sourced resources; make ready handoff and every synthetic table entry explicit opt-in reference data.
minimum_reference_boundary.functional_requirement: Model supported PERF selection as real retained request state. Expose the frequency decoded from the selected reference row explicitly as a requested rate, not a measured/applied L3 clock or completed firmware DVFS transaction. Returning EN=1 alone or accepting arbitrary indices is insufficient.
reference_policy_needed: synthetic ascending unique frequencies and adjacent duplicate sentinel
cold PERF index and enabled handoff
read-only EN/FTBL access policy and unsupported PERF-index policy
same-profile migration identity plus retained PERF and correctly re-derived requested frequency
not_claimed: silicon parent clocks or actual DVFS latency
minimum_reference_boundary.current_authorized_scope_note: Root selected one parent, three windows and requested-only state; no Clock output, timer or IRQ is claimed or required by this source/DT contract.
